PluginData.Tooltip: 0.2.0 diagnostic: requests one exact 1 kg Ice transfer, then verifies inventories after +2s and +5s.
PluginData.Description:
One-shot client plugin for Keen multiplayer server-authority testing.
Setup: - Rename one cargo container containing Ice so its BLOCK NAME includes [IceSource]. - Rename one O2/H2 Generator so its BLOCK NAME includes [IceTest]. - Custom Data is not used for either tag. - Keep both blocks on the grid you are actively controlling from a cockpit or control seat. - Keep the [IceTest] generator OFF during the diagnostic so it does not consume the test Ice. - The plugin disables Use Conveyor and Auto-Refill on the [IceTest] generator. - It requests exactly 1 kg once, records immediate inventory values, then verifies both inventories after 2 seconds and 5 seconds. - The log reports SERVER ACCEPTED, SERVER NOT CONFIRMED, or AMBIGUOUS based on source/target deltas. - The server remains authoritative. - Diagnostics are written to %APPDATA%\SpaceEngineers\IcePulseTest.log.
This is a narrow inventory-transfer proof of concept, not a general Programmable Block script runner.
